name: project-guide
description: A simple standard for laying out, naming, and describing projects, with skills to create a new project to it or bring an existing repository up to it.

interface.shortDescription: Create and adopt projects to one standard.
interface.longDescription: Conventions for a flat projects root, four files every project carries, a project.yaml manifest, naming, private remotes, and worktrees, plus skills that create a new project or bring an existing repository up to the standard in place.
interface.defaultPrompt: Start a new project to the standard.
